# AgentDebugX > 把Agent轨迹转为诊断报告、恢复建议和可区分模拟的重跑记录 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX) - **版本号**：未声明（[固定提交 2437c73c3183e6b6495259dfbb12464a7f07f6b8](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX/tree/2437c73c3183e6b6495259dfbb12464a7f07f6b8)） - **版本日期**：2026-09-20（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核查固定提交的判断根Python调试工具的诊断与重跑证据能否支持安全人工决策。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：已有Agent失败日志的开发者要定位症状并准备恢复。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) [Q01](#research-q01) 统一事件、定位finding和恢复交接，根Python工具独立于DSH桥。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) [Q03](#research-q03) 批准只是元数据、proxy不是任务效果；runner是信任边界。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) [Q05](#research-q05) 可检验诊断辅助是否减少定位负担，当前没有收益数据。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) [Q04](#research-q04) 先脱敏离线heuristic，live需外置审批、隔离runner与外部验收。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) [Q01](#research-q01) 统一事件、定位finding和恢复交接，根Python工具独立于DSH桥。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) [Q03](#research-q03) 批准只是元数据、proxy不是任务效果；runner是信任边界。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) [Q05](#research-q05) 可检验诊断辅助是否减少定位负担，当前没有收益数据。 保留原始日志、盲标根因、报告和外部验收，不按报告confidence自评 ## 场景与替代办法 已有Agent失败日志的开发者要定位症状并准备恢复。 人工看各框架日志并手写恢复步骤。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Python>=3.9<4、Pydantic/httpx | 根工具 | 导入、schema与CLI | 不是DSH子包安装 | | 原始轨迹和可写.agentdebug目录 | 离线诊断 | 可定位事件和报告留存 | 缺上下文易误诊，追加存储需清理 | | 模型端点/凭据 | LLM模式 | 外部归因/模拟 | 审外发与token预算，失败回退口径保留 | | 受信runner/环境/批准 | live模式 | 真实工具与环境执行 | 轨迹本身不可重放，默认元数据不强制批准 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 保存原始轨迹并脱敏，选明确格式/strict_native | 核事件ID与工具配对 | | 离线 | heuristic报告对照已知故障 | 少finding不证明任务成功 | | 选配live | 独立批准、隔离runner和账号，核外部验收 | 模拟和proof自述不得当业务成功 | | 退出 | 停capture/runner，核后代及远端效果，归档再清trace和凭据 | 临时文件删不回滚业务副作用 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | Python环境与轨迹磁盘资源未知 | 规范化和脱敏日志耗时未知 | 离线无模型调用但准备耗时/存储未知 | | 持续 | 可选LLM token与live模型工具资源未知 | 复核finding/归因与runner配置耗时未知 | 费用和准确率未知 | | 恢复 | 轨迹/报告归档与runner残留资源未知 | 核重复效果、停进程与撤凭据耗时未知 | 无自动业务回滚，恢复耗时未知 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 诊断记录 | 代码保存规则finding和归因假设 | 因果准确率、漏报及省时未测 | | 重跑证据 | 模拟/live字段和proof格式校验 | runner声明真实性及任务结果未验 | | 分支比较 | 按event.error数量比较improved | 不证明目标完成或副作用减少 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：判断根Python调试工具的诊断与重跑证据能否支持安全人工决策 ### Q01 · 根工具怎样帮助定位Agent失败？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 Agent开发者已有失败轨迹时，可用Python库/CLI将不同导出规范化为AgentTrajectory，再将症状、归因假设和恢复指令保存在同一报告。root是tool，DSH集成在integrations/dsh-agentdebugx独立子包，不能把两者当同一安装。相比人工读日志，本体贡献是统一事件、可定位finding及便携rerun request；不是自动证明根因或修好任务。local_default明确为无LLM heuristic detector+attributor，恢复器未提供则不运行。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:25-35](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX/blob/2437c73c3183e6b6495259dfbb12464a7f07f6b8/README.md#L25-L35) 作者整体流程与本地定位
查看原文（11行） ```text AgentDebugX turns failed agent runs into structured, auditable debugging artifacts. It ingests a live or exported trajectory, detects visible failure signals, attributes them to responsible steps or agents, proposes recovery actions, and prepares controlled reruns so fixes can be validated instead of guessed. The project is designed for researchers and engineers building complex LLM agents: multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, computer-use agents, benchmark runners, and local agent development workflows. AgentDebugX is local-first by default: traces stay on your machine, sharing is opt-in, and recovery proposals carry explicit policy and approval metadata into the Rerun boundary. ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/agentdebug/diagnose/pipeline.py:43-91](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX/blob/2437c73c3183e6b6495259dfbb12464a7f07f6b8/src/agentdebug/diagnose/pipeline.py#L43-L91) 实际Detect→Attribute→Recover及local默认
查看原文（49行） ```text context: Optional[DiagnoseContext] = None class DiagnosePipeline: """Run Detect -> Attribute -> Recover over one trajectory. Defaults are intentionally local and dependency-free. Passing ``None`` for ``attributor`` or ``recoverer`` disables that sub-stage. """ def __init__( self, *, detector: Optional[DetectorStage] = None, attributor: Optional[Attributor] = None, recoverer: Optional[Recoverer] = None, ) -> None: self.detector = detector or HeuristicAnalyzer() self.attributor = attributor self.recoverer = recoverer @classmethod def local_default(cls) -> 'DiagnosePipeline': """Return a zero-LLM pipeline with deterministic detect + attribution.""" return cls(detector=HeuristicAnalyzer(), attributor=HeuristicAttributor()) def run(self, trajectory: AgentTrajectory) -> DiagnosePipelineResult: report = self.detector.analyze(trajectory) attribution = None recovery = None if self.attributor is not None: attribution = self.attributor.attribute(trajectory, report.findings) report.attribution = _attribution_payload(attribution) context = DiagnoseContext.build(trajectory, report, attribution) if self.recoverer is not None: recovery = suggest_from_context(self.recoverer, context) report.recovery = _recovery_payload(recovery) if recovery: report.suggestions = [proposal.suggestion_text for proposal in recovery] return DiagnosePipelineResult( report=report, context=context, attribution=attribution, recovery=recovery, ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/agentdebug/ingest/adapters/importers.py:116-174](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX/blob/2437c73c3183e6b6495259dfbb12464a7f07f6b8/src/agentdebug/ingest/adapters/importers.py#L116-L174) 导入规范化与strict_native可选
查看原文（59行） ```text def convert_payload( payload: Any, *, format: FormatName = 'auto', trace_id: Optional[str] = None, task_id: Optional[str] = None, goal: Optional[str] = None, framework: Optional[str] = None, strict_native: bool = False, ) -> AgentTrajectory: """Convert an offline trace payload into ``AgentTrajectory``. ``strict_native=True`` refuses a ``messages`` export whose native tool-calling envelope is inconsistent (an assistant ``tool_calls`` id not answered exactly once, an orphan ``tool`` message, a missing or duplicate call id); see :mod:`agentdebug.ingest.native_protocol`. The default stays lenient because text-protocol transcripts carry no envelope at all. ``format='auto'`` is intended for CLI use and common exported logs. Pass an explicit format when a payload is ambiguous, for example a list of objects that could be either messages or events. """ fmt = detect_payload_format(payload) if format == 'auto' else _normalize_format_name(format) if fmt == 'agenttrajectory': if not isinstance(payload, (dict, str)): raise ConversionError('agenttrajectory payload must be a JSON object or string') text = payload if isinstance(payload, str) else json.dumps(payload) traj = trajectory_from_json(text) if trace_id is not None: traj.trace_id = trace_id for event in traj.events: event.trace_id = trace_id if task_id is not None: traj.task_id = task_id if goal is not None: traj.goal = goal if framework is not None: traj.framework = framework return traj if fmt in {'messages', 'message_list'}: messages = payload.get('messages') if isinstance(payload, dict) else payload if strict_native: from agentdebug.ingest.native_protocol import native_tool_message_violations violations = native_tool_message_violations( cast(Sequence[Any], messages), trace_uid=trace_id) if violations: reasons = sorted({str(v['reason']) for v in violations}) raise ConversionError( 'native tool-calling envelope is inconsistent: ' + '; '.join(reasons)) return _convert_messages_payload( payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {'messages': messages}, cast(Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], messages), trace_id=trace_id, task_id=task_id, goal=goal, framework=framework, ) ```
#### 缺口 - 异构导出保真与独立开发者定位效率未测 **影响**：不完整日志可能导致错误归因，不能把规范化成功当保真 **进一步探讨**：先保留原始轨迹，对照事件ID/工具call配对和已知根因样例 ### Q02 · 诊断和重跑真正执行什么？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 heuristic加载事件及轨迹规则，遍历事件生成finding，root选最早step/事件顺序再用confidence打破平局；KeywordRule匹配事件文本关键词，EventErrorRule使用显式error字段。HeuristicAttributor重排finding而非因果干预，corrected_action为None。RerunWorkflow默认只plan，轨迹单独不具live执行能力；配置executor并execute=true才执行，模拟须allow_simulated，输出明示simulated与verified=false。ProcessLiveExecutor将request和完整源轨迹写临时文件，用环境变量传给配置进程，继承os.environ，subprocess.run捕获输出、默认1800s；非零退出/缺JSON失败，之后检proof模式、runner/framework、工具计数与事件。它信任runner声明的observed_execution而非独立捕获所有外部效果。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/agentdebug/diagnose/detect/analyzers.py:37-82](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX/blob/2437c73c3183e6b6495259dfbb12464a7f07f6b8/src/agentdebug/diagnose/detect/analyzers.py#L37-L82) 规则遍历及报告
查看原文（46行） ```text def analyze(self, trajectory: AgentTrajectory) -> DiagnosticReport: pack_names = resolve_rule_pack_names(self.rule_packs, trajectory) event_rules = load_event_rules(pack_names) trajectory_rules = load_trajectory_rules(pack_names) findings = [ finding for event in trajectory.events for finding in self._event_findings(event, trajectory, event_rules) ] findings.extend(self._trajectory_findings(trajectory, trajectory_rules)) # Build event-order map so the root selector can fall back to it when # findings lack step_index (e.g., events recorded via traced_tool on # pre-0.2.4 captures that pre-date the auto-counter). event_order = {evt.event_id: i for i, evt in enumerate(trajectory.events)} root = self._select_root_cause(findings, event_order=event_order) suggestions = self._dedupe( finding.suggestion for finding in findings if finding.suggestion is not None ) report = DiagnosticReport( trace_id=trajectory.trace_id, task_id=trajectory.task_id, findings=findings, suggestions=suggestions, metadata={ 'analyzer': self.__class__.__name__, 'rule_packs': pack_names, 'event_rule_count': len(event_rules), 'trajectory_rule_count': len(trajectory_rules), }, ) if root is not None: report.root_cause_event_id = root.event_id report.root_cause_agent = root.agent_name # If the finding lacked an explicit step_index, fall back to the # event's position so root_cause_step_index is non-null in the UI # and the AgentTraceback header reads sensibly. inferred_step = root.step_index if inferred_step is None and root.event_id is not None: pos = event_order.get(root.event_id) if pos is not None: inferred_step = pos report.root_cause_step_index = inferred_step report.summary = ( f'Likely root cause: {root.failure_mode.name}' f' in {root.agent_name or "unknown agent"}' ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/agentdebug/diagnose/detect/analyzers.py:163-190](https://github.com/AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX/blob/2437c73c3183e6b6495259dfbb12464a7f07f6b8/src/agentdebug/diagnose/detect/analyzers.py#L163-L190) 最早finding选根因
